annotations.title: Check New York LLC Publication Requirements

description: Explains New York's LLC publication requirement: Section 206 of the LLC Law for domestic LLCs, Section 802(b) for foreign LLCs, Section 1203 for PLLCs and Section 1306 for foreign PLLCs. Covers what the statute requires (a notice in two newspapers designated by the county clerk, one daily and one weekly, for six consecutive weeks, and proof of publication filed with the Department of State within 120 days), who it applies to, what Section 206(a) says happens when proof is not filed in time (the LLC's authority to do business is suspended; Section 206 imposes no fine), that New York State continues to accept publication filings after the 120-day window, the capacity-to-sue case law, and common misconceptions (single-member and inactive LLCs, name or address changes, the theatrical exemption). General information, not legal advice. Optionally takes a county for county details. Do NOT use for prices (use llc_publication_get_county_pricing), newspaper or clerk lookups (use llc_publication_get_county_info), or the step-by-step process (use llc_publication_get_process_guide).
